infobox.usage: Unlocks a portable guard cabin next to the trailer park on Customs.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Portable cabin key (Cabin key) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to one of the portable on-site customs control guard cabins.

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the portable guard cabin next to the trailer park on Customs.
